title: Dynamic SLO priority synthesis and noise-gating for latency spike suppression
creator: Maya Patel
description:
Goal: Reduce pagers caused by transient, high-cardinality latency spikes while preserving fidelity of SLO burn-rate alerts for real regressions. Deliver an observable, testable pipeline that synthesizes a dynamic priority score per SLO (release-aware) and a noise-gating pass that suppresses low-confidence signals before they generate burn-rate paging.

Why: On-call noise has increased as we onboard more footprints and release more model variants. Current burn-rate alerts fire aggressively on short-lived spikes (eg warmups, scale events, GC) that are noisy and high-cardinality. We need a middle layer that fuses tracing hooks, metrics rollups, and log-derived enrichments to make alerting decisions more precise.

Scope:
- Instrument tracing hooks to add release tag, model_variant, and request_workload at span ingress points for correlating spikes with deployments.
- Implement a metrics/log fusion stage in the ingestion pipeline that computes: weighted-latency-percentiles (service, route, model_variant), anomaly-score (signal from rolling-window detector), and release-impact factor (fraction of traces in new deploy).
- Build a Dynamic SLO Priority Synthesizer service that consumes fused signals and emits per-SLO priorities: normal / elevated / critical. This informs burn-rate thresholds and paging cadence.
- Add a Noise-Gating pass (configurable) to suppress alerts below a confidence threshold: requires 2x confirmation across signals or >25% traffic impact in last 5m.
- Console surface: a per-SLO timeline showing fused signals, confidence, and the gating decision plus links to representative traces and example log windows.

Non-goals: replacing existing SLO math or primary burn-rate algorithms; instead this layer augments decision inputs and is reversible via rollout flags.
acceptance_criteria: Tracing hooks instrumented for 90% of internal inference ingress paths with release and model_variant tags
Metrics fusion emits synthesized keys for each SLO with anomaly_score and release_impact updated every 60s
Dynamic Priority Synthesizer exposes an API and keystore for SLO -> priority mapping and supports canary rollout
Noise-Gating suppressed >40% of low-confidence pagers in staging without suppressing confirmed regressions during spike experiments
Console displays per-SLO decision timeline and links to 3 representative traces for each gating event
comments: 2026-02-22: Discovery notes added. Spike: ran offline fusion over 7 days of prod metrics — found 18% of burn-rate triggers correlated with <3m release windows.
2026-02-28: Design review w/ PM (Aria Chen) and SRE (Samir Bose). Agreed on evidence tiers: trace-confirmed, metric-confirmed, log-confirmed.
2026-03-03: Prototype service (repo: github.com/redwood-inference/obs/dynamic-priority) pushed. Initial API: /synthesize?slo=<id>&window=5m returns {priority,confidence}.
2026-03-06: Load test results: synthesis service at 10k QPS p95 cpu 120ms. Need to optimize cache for high-cardinality SLOs.
2026-03-10: UX PRD posted (drive link: https://drive.redwood.com/obs/dynamic-priority-prd). UX wants small inline chart in console + drillthrough to traces.
2026-03-12: Security review flagged need to mask customer identifiers in fused payloads — adding transform step in pipeline.
2026-03-13: Implemented gating rule: require at least 2 signal tiers or >=25% traffic impact to bypass suppression. Running canary on staging for runtime-1.18 clusters.
